_comment: Template: Export SHACL shape files to an Excel workbook.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar shacl2xlsx --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: To review, filter or share a constraint set without reading Turtle. Same export as the GUI's Tools > Export SHACL constraints information to Excel.
_note_shaclFiles: One or more SHACL files (.ttl, .rdf; JSON-LD is refused). Relative paths resolve against this file's folder.
_note_output: The .xlsx workbook to write. Parent folders are created; an existing file is replaced.
_note_layout: 'summary' (default): one row per constraint, one sheet per file. 'by-type': every predicate of every shape, one sheet per shape kind (NodeShapes, PropertyShapes, SPARQLConstraints, PropertyGroups), with a 'Source file' column when there are several files.
